data.one_liner: A set of widgets for implementing glassmorphism UI designs in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use widgets like GlassContainer, GlassAppBar, GlassButton, and GlassListTile designed to mimic glassmorphic aesthetics. It supports customizable blur, gradients, borders, and a global theme configuration via GlassThemeData.
use_when: You want to build a user interface with a glassmorphism style across your Flutter app.
You need Material-like components such AppBars, ListTiles, and Bottom Navigation Bars styled with glass effects.
avoid_when: You are using the Flutter master channel, as GlassFloatingActionButton has known issues there.
You require complex animations or non-glass widget setups.
strengths: Easy to customize blur, gradients, and shapes for glass components.
Includes familiar Material-like widget equivalents like GlassAppBar and GlassBottomBar.
Supports global styling using GlassApp and GlassThemeData.
weaknesses: Currently supports only the stable Flutter channel.
GlassFloatingActionButton has compatibility issues on the Flutter master channel.
